input.encoding: Each node is [ignored signed value, left child index, right child index]; -1 means no child.
input.root_index: The root can have any table index; an empty tree uses -1.
input.tree_requirement: A valid rooted binary tree with every node reachable exactly once, or the empty tree.
input.result: Maximum number of nodes on any root-to-leaf path; an empty tree returns zero.
